ideas.title: Following the Money: COVID Relief Funds and Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the use of COVID relief funds and the prevalence of fraud schemes
questions: How much COVID relief funding has been allocated to Minnesota?
What measures are in place to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and highlight the need for increased oversight in government funding. I recommend starting with public records and data analysis to identify trends and patterns.
